text:
Evidence favors interpreting uniform-prefix terminal masking as inference alignment, not explicit recency sampling. Original [BERT4Rec](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.06690) already supplements random Cloze masking with last-item-only training to match appended-mask inference; it uses learned positional embeddings and truncates long histories. [Recency Sampling](https://arxiv.org/html/2207.02643) instead gives newer interactions higher target-selection probability. Its experiments concern GRU4Rec, Caser and SASRec, so they do not directly establish benefits for this BERT4Rec modification. Neither source isolates the proposed left-padding configuration.

Analytical implication: for a user with n interactions, uniformly choosing target endpoint t∈{2,…,n} gives context length C=min(t−1,L−1), where L includes the mask. Short contexts each receive probability 1/(n−1); remaining mass accumulates at L−1. This is uniform over eligible targets within that user, not recency-weighted; user sampling also determines aggregate interaction weights. With fixed-width left padding, every terminal mask occupies absolute slot L−1, matching inference. Thus endpoint sampling simultaneously changes context lengths and truncation, while terminal masking changes future-context availability and supervision of the final positional embedding. These are deductions, not published effect estimates.

Controlled ablations should hold architecture, loss, optimizer, updates and supervised-target counts fixed: compare terminal-only versus mixed Cloze training using identical endpoint draws; compare uniform versus recent-biased endpoints within matched context-length strata; cross endpoint policy with independently controlled context caps. To isolate positional alignment, keep tokens, padding and attention identical while varying position IDs: standard right-aligned IDs versus consistently reindexed IDs at training and inference. Log target age, visible-context length, truncation rate and target-position frequencies; stratify validation HR@10 by history length. Train each variant independently, with one checkpoint per category. A large expected benefit remains unsubstantiated until these controls separate alignment from recency and truncation.
